command: capability_audit(real CLI, disposable repo, empty MCP allow-list)

capabilities.name: mcp_servers
capabilities.note: snapshot-scoped: 2 disabled at audit time; the CLI has no deny-all mechanism, so a server added to the configuration after the audit is not covered (rechecked immediately before exec and after the turn)

capabilities.control: feature gates: multi_agent (+ multi_agent_v2 when present)
capabilities.name: delegation
capabilities.note: resolved = CLI effective-state readout; removal of the tools at runtime needs a live tool listing

capabilities.name: web_search
capabilities.note: key exists in the CLI's config schema; the CLI offers no readout for it and the `web__run` tool observed in live runs has not been mapped to this key

capabilities.name: shell_and_apply_patch_writes
capabilities.note: argv content is guarded at build time; effectiveness is shown by the attack tests recorded in the evidence files, not by this audit

capabilities.name: view_image_goals_sleep_skills
capabilities.note: view_image can read local image files; skills under ~/.codex and ~/.agents inject instructions; neither is a repository write route

what: effective capability policy read from the installed CLI (model-free; no sandbox preflight, no inference)
